decision.reason: [ev-b9e3037ef8b7] is a one-line changelog entry. It says the Loki ruler can now notify remote storage about WAL writes, and otherwise it only points to PR 10906. It names no config key, flag or field. It doesn't say whether the behaviour is opt-in or on by default, gives no before/after values, and doesn't say what changes for an environment where the operator does nothing. Writing the typed assertion would need the PR or the ruler configuration docs, which show the mechanism and its default.
